_description: CCNL Edilizia Industria ANCE (CNEL F012), operaio comune at level 1, April 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the tranche of 1 March 2026.
_notes: Row 'Operaio Comune liv. 1' of the ANCE Ragusa table of 1 March 2026: retribuzione base mensile 1.117,36, indennità di contingenza 512,87, E.D.R. 10,33.
The base is the national minimo of level I from 1 March 2026 (ANCE table of the CCNL of 21 February 2025); contingenza and EDR are the bundle's fixed allowances (523.20).
The indennità territoriale di settore (166,67, provincial) and the 18.5% and 4.95% percentages are not modelled: the period gross is not pinned.
